description: Taipei Meowcast full-year 2027 calendar; eight planned H2 artworks, all 2026 autumn/winter artwork reused from mid-autumn, explicit evening events on overlapping dates.

sources.name: NAOJ 2027 solar terms; JST converted to Asia/Taipei (same H1 dates)

2027-01-01.caption_en: New-year goal: less worry, more sleep. I'll demonstrate the sleep part.
2027-01-01.caption_zh: 新年目標：少一點焦慮，多一點睡眠。後半句我先示範。

2027-01-05.caption_en: Minor Cold is on the calendar: another excuse for a cosy lie-in. Let the forecast choose your layers.
2027-01-05.caption_zh: 小寒到了，衣服多一件，賴床的理由也多一個。實際穿多少，記得看預報。

2027-01-20.caption_en: Major Cold has arrived on the calendar. The duvet is now essential infrastructure; check the temperature before dressing.
2027-01-20.caption_zh: 大寒登場，我宣布棉被升格為重要生活設施。穿搭還是請看今天的氣溫。

2027-02-04.name_en: Start of Lunar New Year Holiday
2027-02-04.caption_en: The Lunar New Year break begins. Pack the essentials and leave room for rest.
2027-02-04.caption_zh: 春節假期開始，把必需品帶好，也替休息留個位置。

also.caption_en: Beginning of Spring: the annual stretching programme is open. First, a preparatory nap.
also.caption_zh: 立春了，年度伸懶腰計畫正式啟動。進度：先睡一下。

2027-02-05.caption_en: Lunar New Year's Eve: good company, a welcoming table, and no annual performance review for the cat. I'll inspect the empty boxes.
2027-02-05.caption_zh: 除夕團圓，願大家吃得開心、聊得自在。我負責巡視空紙箱，不負責回答年終問題。

2027-02-06.caption_en: Happy Lunar New Year! Wishing you peace and good luck. You keep the red envelopes; I'll take the empty box.
2027-02-06.caption_zh: 新年快樂！祝你平安順心。我不搶紅包，只搶紅包袋旁邊的空盒。

2027-02-07.caption_en: Day two: bring your good wishes when visiting loved ones.
2027-02-07.caption_zh: 初二走春，帶上祝福，也記得留意交通與天氣。

2027-02-08.caption_en: Day three: a slow morning and a comfortable window seat.
2027-02-08.caption_zh: 初三放慢腳步，窗邊的好位置先讓貓坐一下。

2027-02-09.name_en: Lunar New Year: Day 4 / Day 1 Observed
2027-02-09.caption_en: Day four and the observed holiday for day one: enjoy a gentle stroll.
2027-02-09.caption_zh: 初四，也是初一補假日。散個步，讓年假再慢一點。

2027-02-10.name_en: Lunar New Year: Day 5 / Day 2 Observed
2027-02-10.caption_en: Day five and the observed holiday for day two: wishing you a peaceful, prosperous year.
2027-02-10.caption_zh: 初五，也是初二補假日。祝你新的一年平安順心。

2027-02-11.name_en: Back to Work after Lunar New Year
2027-02-11.caption_en: Back to work after the break. Start with one small task and check the forecast before commuting.
2027-02-11.caption_zh: 春節後上班，先完成一件小事。通勤前也記得看看天氣。

2027-02-14.caption_en: Valentine's Day: save some kindness for your favourite people and yourself. The cat on the sofa has already collected its share.
2027-02-14.caption_zh: 情人節，把溫柔留給喜歡的人。也留一點給自己，沙發上的貓已經自行領取。

2027-02-19.caption_en: Rain Water is a solar term, not a promise of rain. Check the forecast; a calendar makes a terrible umbrella.
2027-02-19.caption_zh: 今天是雨水，節氣名稱不是降雨保證。出門看預報，別拿日曆當雨傘。

2027-02-28.caption_en: A quiet day to remember history, value peace, and care for the people around us.
2027-02-28.caption_zh: 今天留一點安靜，記得歷史、珍惜和平，也好好照顧身邊的人。

2027-03-01.caption_en: An observed holiday for Peace Memorial Day. Take time to rest and value peace.
2027-03-01.caption_zh: 和平紀念日補假，留些時間休息，也珍惜平安的日常。

2027-03-06.caption_en: Awakening of Insects: the calendar calls for waking up. I've stretched; full consciousness is still under review.
2027-03-06.caption_zh: 驚蟄到了，日曆提醒萬物甦醒。我已經伸過懶腰，醒來這件事再議。

2027-03-21.caption_en: Spring Equinox is about balance. My version: a nap on the left, then one on the right.
2027-03-21.caption_zh: 春分講究平衡。我的版本是左邊躺一下，右邊也不能漏掉。

2027-03-28.caption_en: Happy Easter! Make room for play and new beginnings.
2027-03-28.caption_zh: 復活節快樂！留點時間玩耍，也迎接新的開始。

2027-04-04.caption_en: Children's Day: room to play, ask questions, and be heard. Grown-ups may let their playful side out too.
2027-04-04.caption_zh: 兒童節，祝小朋友有得玩、有得問，也有人好好聽。大人今天也可以把玩心放出來透透氣。

2027-04-05.caption_en: Qingming: a gentle moment for remembrance. Check the weather and your route when visiting family or paying respects.
2027-04-05.caption_zh: 清明，把思念輕輕留在心裡。出門祭祖或探親，記得留意路況與天氣。

2027-04-06.caption_en: Children's Day observed: one more chance to play together.
2027-04-06.caption_zh: 兒童節補假，多一點陪伴，也多一點一起玩的時間。

2027-04-20.caption_en: Grain Rain marks spring's handover. My seasonal transitions are simpler: find a different nap spot.
2027-04-20.caption_zh: 穀雨到了，春天準備交班。貓的四季交班比較簡單：換個地方睡。

2027-04-30.caption_en: Labour Day observed: thank you for your work. Enjoy a well-earned pause.
2027-04-30.caption_zh: 勞動節補假，謝謝每一份努力。今天也替自己留個休息的位置。

2027-05-01.caption_en: Labour Day: thank you for all the work you do. Make room for rest; the cat has extensive experience.
2027-05-01.caption_zh: 勞動節，謝謝每一份努力，也別忘了休息。貓的休息資歷很深，歡迎參考。

2027-05-06.caption_en: Beginning of Summer: the calendar changes mode. Let the temperature decide the air conditioning, not my dramatic flopping.
2027-05-06.caption_zh: 立夏，日曆進入夏季模式。冷氣要不要開，請看溫度，不要看我演得多累。

2027-05-09.caption_en: Mother's Day: thank you for the everyday care. Don't just suggest a break; take over a chore. The cat will supervise.
2027-05-09.caption_zh: 母親節，謝謝那些被當成理所當然的小事。今天別只說『妳休息』，也把家事接過去。貓會監工。

2027-05-21.caption_en: Grain Buds: life needn't be full to the brim. Fewer tasks, fewer appointments. The food bowl is still under negotiation.
2027-05-21.caption_zh: 小滿提醒我們，不必事事全滿。待辦不用滿，行程不用滿，飯碗這題我保留意見。

2027-06-06.caption_en: Grain in Ear: plant a small intention and take a small step. Don't just plant yourself on the sofa like me.
2027-06-06.caption_zh: 芒種，適合把想做的事種下去。先做一小步，別像我只把自己種在沙發裡。

2027-06-09.caption_en: Dragon Boat Festival: enjoy your zongzi; I'll inspect the packaging. Keep your schedule less tightly packed than lunch.
2027-06-09.caption_zh: 端午節，粽子你吃，包裝我看。祝你過節開心，別讓行程塞得比粽子還滿。

2027-06-21.caption_en: Summer Solstice brings long Northern Hemisphere days. You don't have to fill every extra moment with work. Stretching is an option.
2027-06-21.caption_zh: 夏至，北半球白晝很長。長出來的時間不用全拿來忙，也可以拿來伸個懶腰。

2027-07-07.caption_en: Minor Heat: check today's Taipei weather and take good care of yourself. The cat is on forecast duty.
2027-07-07.caption_zh: 小暑到了，出門記得看台北天氣預報。本貓照常值班。
